aiVerification.summary: Draft has citeable evidence but misidentifies the changed factor and includes unreliable grouped measurements.
issues: Changed factor conflates outcome labels with test condition.
Primary change should be AWF #2 increased temperature and tension.
Temperature/tension stats use wrong dimension spec and bad grouping.
Function outcome duplicates total and dated rows.
Many NTI/FO measurements are unjudged bulk extracts, not validated outcomes.
correctionPlan: Set changed factor to AWF #2 increased temperature and tension.
Use Coil Test versus Normal as conditions under that factor.
Keep vision spot and function NG as outcomes in one report.
Remove or separately validate unjudged NTI/FO bulk measurements.
Cite purpose, condition, AWF settings, outcome rows, and decision rows.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Row citations exist but are insufficiently targeted and partly misassigned.
